items.question: Trong câu "They are two answers to two different questions about uncertainty.", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are two answers to two different questions about uncertainty.", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (danh từ): sự không chắc chắn. "Uncertainty" = mức độ chưa biết trước; cụm "high uncertainty" hay dùng khi chọn Agile hay Waterfall.
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (noun): not knowing what will happen. "Uncertainty" is how much is still unknown; "high uncertainty" is a key factor when choosing Agile or Waterfall.

items.question: Trong câu "Waterfall assumes: we can know in advance what must be built.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waterfall assumes: we can know in advance what must be built.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take as true without proof
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định, cho rằng. "Waterfall assumes..." = mô hình Waterfall giả định rằng...; nghĩa khác "assume responsibility" = đảm nhận trách nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true without proof. "Waterfall assumes..." means the model takes something as true; another sense is "assume responsibility".

items.question: Trong câu "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", từ "sequentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", what does "sequentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): tuần tự, lần lượt. "Work sequentially" = làm tuần tự từng giai đoạn; trái nghĩa "in parallel".
items.explanationEn: sequentially /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): one step after another. "Work sequentially" means doing phases one after another; the opposite is "in parallel".

items.question: Trong câu "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", từ "waste" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", what does "waste" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (danh từ): sự lãng phí. "No waste on replanning" = không lãng phí vào việc lập lại kế hoạch; "a waste of time" = phí thời gian.
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (noun): a careless loss of resources. "No waste on replanning" means no effort lost redoing plans; compare "a waste of time".

items.question: Trong câu "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that assumption holds, working sequentially is most efficient — no waste on replanning, no cost of iteration.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): vòng lặp làm lại. "Iteration" = một vòng lặp phát triển; động từ "iterate", tính từ "iterative".
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one round of repeating work. An "iteration" is one repeated development cycle; verb "iterate", adjective "iterative".

items.question: Trong câu "Making a new product for an untouched market", từ "untouched" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making a new product for an untouched market", what does "untouched" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (tính từ): chưa ai khai thác. "An untouched market" = thị trường chưa ai khai thác; đồng nghĩa "untapped market".
items.explanationEn: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (adjective): not yet explored by anyone. "An untouched market" is one nobody has entered yet; synonym "untapped market".

items.question: Trong câu "Improving conversion on a checkout flow", từ "conversion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Improving conversion on a checkout flow", what does "conversion" (noun) mean?
options: sự chuyển đổi định dạng tệp
items.explanation: conversion /kənˈvɜː.ʃən/ (danh từ): tỉ lệ khách mua hàng. "Conversion rate" = tỉ lệ khách truy cập thực hiện hành động mong muốn (mua, đăng ký).
items.explanationEn: conversion /kənˈvɜː.ʃən/ (noun): visitors turning into buyers. "Conversion rate" is the share of visitors who complete a desired action such as buying.

items.question: Trong câu "only real data reveals what works", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "only real data reveals what works", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): cho thấy, làm lộ ra. "Data reveals what works" = dữ liệu cho thấy điều gì hiệu quả; danh từ "revelation".
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make known. "Data reveals what works" means data shows it; the noun is "revelation".

items.question: Trong câu "The costliest mistake is not choosing the wrong model but choosing one and applying it half-heartedly.", từ "half-heartedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The costliest mistake is not choosing the wrong model but choosing one and applying it half-heartedly.", what does "half-heartedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: half-heartedly /ˌhɑːfˈhɑː.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): nửa vời, thiếu quyết tâm. "Apply something half-heartedly" = áp dụng nửa vời; trái nghĩa "wholeheartedly".
items.explanationEn: half-heartedly /ˌhɑːfˈhɑː.tɪd.li/ (adverb): without real commitment. "Apply something half-heartedly" means without real effort; the opposite is "wholeheartedly".

items.question: Trong câu "Waterfall without change control and Agile without real feedback are both worse than either original model.", từ "change control" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waterfall without change control and Agile without real feedback are both worse than either original model.", what does "change control" (phrase) mean?
options: quy trình kiểm soát thay đổi
items.explanation: change control /tʃeɪndʒ kənˈtrəʊl/ (cụm từ): quy trình kiểm soát thay đổi. "Change control" = quy trình đánh giá và duyệt yêu cầu thay đổi; cụm "change request".
items.explanationEn: change control /tʃeɪndʒ kənˈtrəʊl/ (phrase): a process for approving changes. "Change control" is the process for assessing and approving changes; related: "change request".

items.question: Trong câu "Detailed once, then defended", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailed once, then defended", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ, giữ nguyên. "A plan that is defended" = kế hoạch được bảo vệ, giữ nguyên trước thay đổi; "defend a thesis" = bảo vệ luận văn.
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to protect from change. A plan that is "defended" is protected against change; compare "defend a thesis".

items.question: Trong câu "Measure deviation from baseline", từ "deviation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measure deviation from baseline", what does "deviation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deviation /ˌdiː.viˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): độ lệch so với chuẩn. "Deviation from baseline" = độ lệch so với kế hoạch gốc; "standard deviation" = độ lệch chuẩn.
items.explanationEn: deviation /ˌdiː.viˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a difference from a standard. "Deviation from baseline" is how far results differ from the original plan; compare "standard deviation".

items.question: Trong câu "Measure deviation from baseline", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measure deviation from baseline", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a line on a sports court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): kế hoạch gốc được duyệt. "Baseline" = mốc gốc (phạm vi, tiến độ, chi phí) để so sánh tiến độ thực tế.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): the approved original plan. A "baseline" is the approved starting plan used to measure actual progress.

items.question: Trong câu "Clear impediments and protect the pace", từ "impediment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear impediments and protect the pace", what does "impediment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impediment /ɪmˈped.ɪ.mənt/ (danh từ): trở ngại. "Impediment" = trở ngại cản trở nhóm; cụm "remove impediments" rất hay dùng trong Scrum.
items.explanationEn: impediment /ɪmˈped.ɪ.mənt/ (noun): an obstacle. An "impediment" is an obstacle that slows the team; "remove impediments" is common in Scrum.

items.question: Trong câu "Clear impediments and protect the pace", từ "pace" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear impediments and protect the pace", what does "pace" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pace /peɪs/ (danh từ): nhịp độ, tốc độ. "Sustainable pace" = nhịp làm việc bền vững; cụm "keep pace with" = theo kịp.
items.explanationEn: pace /peɪs/ (noun): the speed of progress. "Sustainable pace" is a work speed a team can keep; "keep pace with" means keep up with.

items.question: Trong câu "Somebody still answers for the budget and for external commitments.", từ "answer for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Somebody still answers for the budget and for external commitments.", what does "answer for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: answer for /ˈɑːn.sər fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chịu trách nhiệm về. "Answer for something" = chịu trách nhiệm về việc gì; khác "answer to someone" = báo cáo cho ai.
items.explanationEn: answer for /ˈɑːn.sər fɔːr/ (phrase): to be responsible for. "Answer for something" means being accountable for it; "answer to someone" means reporting to them.

items.question: Trong câu "Somebody still answers for the budget and for external commitments.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Somebody still answers for the budget and for external commitments.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): cam kết đã hứa. "External commitments" = các cam kết với bên ngoài (khách hàng, đối tác); cụm "make a commitment".
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise to deliver. "External commitments" are promises made to outside parties; you "make a commitment".

items.question: Trong câu "Somebody still communicates upward in leadership's language, not in burndown charts.", từ "upward" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Somebody still communicates upward in leadership's language, not in burndown charts.", what does "upward" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: upward /ˈʌp.wəd/ (trạng từ): lên cấp trên. "Communicate upward" = báo cáo, trao đổi với cấp trên; cụm "upward reporting".
items.explanationEn: upward /ˈʌp.wəd/ (adverb): to higher levels. "Communicate upward" means reporting to senior management; compare "upward reporting".

items.question: Trong câu "In that context the PO and Scrum Master divide the responsibility adequately.", từ "adequately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In that context the PO and Scrum Master divide the responsibility adequately.", what does "adequately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: adequately /ˈæd.ə.kwət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách đủ, thoả đáng. "Adequately" = đủ đáp ứng, ở mức chấp nhận được; tính từ "adequate".
items.explanationEn: adequately /ˈæd.ə.kwət.li/ (adverb): well enough. "Adequately" means well enough for the need; the adjective is "adequate".

items.question: Trong câu "The moment there are several teams, several dependencies, or a contract — the PM work reappears, whatever the title.", từ "reappear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moment there are several teams, several dependencies, or a contract — the PM work reappears, whatever the title.", what does "reappear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reappear /ˌriː.əˈpɪər/ (động từ): xuất hiện trở lại. Tiền tố "re-" = lại: "reappear" = xuất hiện lại, "the moment..." = ngay khi.
items.explanationEn: reappear /ˌriː.əˈpɪər/ (verb): to show up again. The prefix "re-" means again: "reappear" is to show up again; "the moment..." means as soon as.

items.question: Trong câu "When three teams build one product, dependencies between them do not vanish.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When three teams build one product, dependencies between them do not vanish.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Do not vanish" = không biến mất; đồng nghĩa trang trọng của "disappear".
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. "Do not vanish" means they do not disappear; a more vivid synonym of "disappear".

items.question: Trong câu "No Scrum team negotiates its way out of a partner being two months late with an API.", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No Scrum team negotiates its way out of a partner being two months late with an API.", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to discuss to reach a deal
items.explanation: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): đàm phán, thương lượng. "Negotiate one's way out of something" = thương lượng để thoát khỏi tình huống; "negotiate a contract".
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to discuss to reach a deal. "Negotiate one's way out of something" means escaping it by bargaining; e.g. "negotiate a contract".

items.question: Trong câu "They need: how much spent, what was gained, which risks, and what decision is needed from them.", từ "gain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They need: how much spent, what was gained, which risks, and what decision is needed from them.", what does "gain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: gain /ɡeɪn/ (động từ): thu được, đạt được. "What was gained" = đã thu được gì; cụm "gain experience", "gain market share".
items.explanationEn: gain /ɡeɪn/ (verb): to obtain as a benefit. "What was gained" means what benefit was obtained; e.g. "gain experience", "gain market share".

items.question: Trong câu "Staffing, contracts, compliance, architecture — the risks outside one sprint's field of view.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Staffing, contracts, compliance, architecture — the risks outside one sprint's field of view.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ quy định. "Compliance" = việc tuân thủ luật và quy chuẩn; cụm "compliance requirements", "be in compliance with".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules and laws. "Compliance" means following laws and standards; e.g. "compliance requirements".

items.question: Trong câu "Staffing, contracts, compliance, architecture — the risks outside one sprint's field of view.", từ "field of view" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Staffing, contracts, compliance, architecture — the risks outside one sprint's field of view.", what does "field of view" (phrase) mean?
options: tầm nhìn, phạm vi quan sát
items.explanation: field of view /fiːld əv vjuː/ (cụm từ): tầm nhìn, phạm vi quan sát. "Outside one's field of view" = nằm ngoài tầm quan sát; nghĩa đen dùng cho camera, mắt người.
items.explanationEn: field of view /fiːld əv vjuː/ (phrase): the range you can see. "Outside one's field of view" means beyond what can be seen; literally used for cameras and eyes.

items.question: Trong câu "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", từ "negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", what does "negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negotiable /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thương lượng. "Not negotiable" = không thể thương lượng; cụm "non-negotiable" = bắt buộc.
items.explanationEn: negotiable /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (adjective): open to discussion. "Not negotiable" means fixed and not open to discussion; also "non-negotiable".

items.question: Trong câu "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", từ "come into force" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", what does "come into force" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come into force /kʌm ˈɪn.tuː fɔːs/ (cụm từ): bắt đầu có hiệu lực. "Come into force" = (luật) bắt đầu có hiệu lực; đồng nghĩa "take effect".
items.explanationEn: come into force /kʌm ˈɪn.tuː fɔːs/ (phrase): to start to apply. "Come into force" means a law starts to apply; synonym "take effect".

items.question: Trong câu "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", từ "trade show" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some dates are not negotiable: marketing campaigns, regulations coming into force, industry trade shows.", what does "trade show" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: trade show /treɪd ʃəʊ/ (cụm từ): hội chợ triển lãm ngành. "Trade show" = hội chợ, triển lãm thương mại của một ngành; đồng nghĩa "trade fair".
items.explanationEn: trade show /treɪd ʃəʊ/ (phrase): an industry exhibition. A "trade show" is an exhibition where an industry shows products; synonym "trade fair".

items.question: Trong câu "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển thành. "Convert A into B" = chuyển A thành B; cũng dùng "convert a file", "convert visitors".
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into. "Convert A into B" means turning A into B; also "convert a file", "convert visitors".

items.question: Trong câu "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực làm việc. "Team capacity" = lượng việc nhóm làm được trong một khoảng thời gian; "in my capacity as PM" = với tư cách PM.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): the amount of work possible. "Team capacity" is how much work a team can do in a period; "in my capacity as PM" means in my role.

items.question: Trong câu "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM converts those dates into constraints the team understands, and the team's capacity into forecasts outsiders understand.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo. "Forecast" = dự báo dựa trên dữ liệu; "weather forecast", "sales forecast".
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (noun): a prediction. A "forecast" is a prediction based on data; e.g. "weather forecast", "sales forecast".

items.question: Trong câu "No test environment, a three-week approval process, missing access rights.", từ "access rights" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No test environment, a three-week approval process, missing access rights.", what does "access rights" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: access rights /ˈæk.ses raɪts/ (cụm từ): quyền truy cập. "Access rights" = quyền truy cập hệ thống/dữ liệu; cụm "grant access" = cấp quyền.
items.explanationEn: access rights /ˈæk.ses raɪts/ (phrase): permission to use a system. "Access rights" are permissions to use a system or data; you "grant access".

items.question: Trong câu "The boundary must stay sharp", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The boundary must stay sharp", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "The boundary must stay sharp" = ranh giới trách nhiệm phải rõ ràng; "set boundaries".
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing limit. "The boundary must stay sharp" means the limit of responsibility must stay clear; "set boundaries".

items.question: Trong câu "The boundary must stay sharp", từ "sharp" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The boundary must stay sharp", what does "sharp" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sharp /ʃɑːp/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, dứt khoát. "Stay sharp" ở đây = giữ rõ ràng; "at 9 sharp" = đúng 9 giờ, "a sharp knife" = dao sắc.
items.explanationEn: sharp /ʃɑːp/ (adjective): clearly defined. Here "stay sharp" means stay clearly defined; "at 9 sharp" means exactly 9, "a sharp knife" cuts well.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who crosses into those three breaks the very mechanism that makes Agile work.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who crosses into those three breaks the very mechanism that makes Agile work.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế vận hành. "The mechanism that makes Agile work" = cơ chế giúp Agile vận hành; "the very" nhấn mạnh "chính".
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (noun): a way something works. "The mechanism that makes Agile work" is the process behind it; "the very" stresses "exactly that".

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who crosses into those three breaks the very mechanism that makes Agile work.", từ "cross into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who crosses into those three breaks the very mechanism that makes Agile work.", what does "cross into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cross into /krɒs ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lấn sang (phạm vi khác). "Cross into someone's area" = lấn sang phạm vi của người khác; "cross the line" = vượt giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: cross into /krɒs ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to enter another area. "Cross into someone's area" means entering their territory; "cross the line" means going too far.

items.question: Trong câu "Most real projects are hybrids, and that is not a failure of theory — it is a rational response to a reality that has both clear and uncertain parts.", từ "rational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most real projects are hybrids, and that is not a failure of theory — it is a rational response to a reality that has both clear and uncertain parts.", what does "rational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rational /ˈræʃ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, có lý trí. "A rational response" = một phản ứng hợp lý; trái nghĩa "irrational".
items.explanationEn: rational /ˈræʃ.ən.əl/ (adjective): based on reason. "A rational response" is a sensible one; the opposite is "irrational".

items.question: Trong câu "Most real projects are hybrids, and that is not a failure of theory — it is a rational response to a reality that has both clear and uncertain parts.", từ "hybrid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most real projects are hybrids, and that is not a failure of theory — it is a rational response to a reality that has both clear and uncertain parts.", what does "hybrid" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (danh từ): mô hình kết hợp. "Hybrid" = sự pha trộn hai cách làm; nghĩa khác "hybrid car", giống cây lai.
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪ.brɪd/ (noun): a mix of two approaches. A "hybrid" mixes two approaches; other senses are "hybrid car" and a crossbred plant.

items.question: Trong câu "Initiation and overall planning done traditionally; construction done in sprints.", từ "initiation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiation and overall planning done traditionally; construction done in sprints.", what does "initiation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃ.iˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): giai đoạn khởi động. "Project initiation" = giai đoạn khởi tạo dự án; động từ "initiate".
items.explanationEn: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃ.iˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the starting phase. "Project initiation" is the starting phase of a project; the verb is "initiate".

items.question: Trong câu "Initiation and overall planning done traditionally; construction done in sprints.", từ "traditionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiation and overall planning done traditionally; construction done in sprints.", what does "traditionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: traditionally /trəˈdɪʃ.ən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): theo cách truyền thống. "Done traditionally" = làm theo lối truyền thống (ở đây là kiểu Waterfall).
items.explanationEn: traditionally /trəˈdɪʃ.ən.əl.i/ (adverb): in the usual long-standing way. "Done traditionally" means in the long-established way (here, Waterfall style).

items.question: Trong câu "Fits when budget must be approved once for the whole project while the content stays flexible.", từ "flexible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fits when budget must be approved once for the whole project while the content stays flexible.", what does "flexible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flexible /ˈflek.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): linh hoạt, dễ thay đổi. "Stays flexible" = vẫn linh hoạt; cụm "flexible working hours" = giờ làm linh hoạt.
items.explanationEn: flexible /ˈflek.sə.bəl/ (adjective): open to change. "Stays flexible" means remains open to change; e.g. "flexible working hours".

items.question: Trong câu "The most pragmatic form, because it puts each kind of work into the model that suits it.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most pragmatic form, because it puts each kind of work into the model that suits it.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "The model that suits it" = mô hình phù hợp với nó; "suit yourself" = tuỳ bạn.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "The model that suits it" is the one right for it; "suit yourself" means do as you like.

items.question: Trong câu "The team runs real Scrum; upward reporting is translated into milestones and percentages.", từ "translate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team runs real Scrum; upward reporting is translated into milestones and percentages.", what does "translate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi sang dạng khác. "Translate into milestones" = chuyển thông tin sang dạng mốc tiến độ; nghĩa gốc là dịch.
items.explanationEn: translate /trænsˈleɪt/ (verb): to turn into another form. "Translate into milestones" means expressing the information in another form; the basic sense is changing language.

items.question: Trong câu "Valid if the translation is honest; dangerous if the team must maintain two parallel planning systems.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Valid if the translation is honest; dangerous if the team must maintain two parallel planning systems.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì, vận hành. "Maintain two systems" = duy trì hai hệ thống cùng lúc; danh từ "maintenance".
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep going. "Maintain two systems" means keeping both running; the noun is "maintenance".

items.question: Trong câu "The team carries every cost of Agile with none of the benefit — nothing adjusts to learning", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team carries every cost of Agile with none of the benefit — nothing adjusts to learning", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh theo. "Adjust to something" = điều chỉnh để thích nghi với; danh từ "adjustment".
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change to fit. "Adjust to something" means changing to fit it; the noun is "adjustment".

items.question: Trong câu "The feedback loop is severed, leaving only ceremony", từ "sever" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The feedback loop is severed, leaving only ceremony", what does "sever" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sever /ˈsev.ər/ (động từ): cắt đứt. "Sever ties/a connection" = cắt đứt quan hệ/kết nối; đừng nhầm với "severe" (nghiêm trọng).
items.explanationEn: sever /ˈsev.ər/ (verb): to cut off. "Sever ties or a connection" means cutting them off; do not confuse it with "severe".

items.question: Trong câu "The feedback loop is severed, leaving only ceremony", từ "ceremony" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The feedback loop is severed, leaving only ceremony", what does "ceremony" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (danh từ): hình thức rỗng. Ở đây "only ceremony" = chỉ còn hình thức; trong Scrum "ceremonies" lại chỉ các cuộc họp chuẩn như planning, review.
items.explanationEn: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (noun): empty formality. Here "only ceremony" means empty formality; in Scrum, "ceremonies" also names the standard events.

items.question: Trong câu "The rule that makes a hybrid work: every variable must have somewhere to give.", từ "variable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule that makes a hybrid work: every variable must have somewhere to give.", what does "variable" (noun) mean?
options: yếu tố có thể thay đổi
items.explanation: variable /ˈveə.ri.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): yếu tố có thể thay đổi. "Every variable" ở đây = mỗi yếu tố (phạm vi, thời hạn, chất lượng); trong lập trình "variable" là biến.
items.explanationEn: variable /ˈveə.ri.ə.bəl/ (noun): a factor that can change. "Every variable" here means each factor (scope, date, quality); in programming it is a named value.

items.question: Trong câu "How knowable are the requirements up front?", từ "knowable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How knowable are the requirements up front?", what does "knowable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: knowable /ˈnəʊ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể biết trước. "Knowable" = có thể biết được; hậu tố "-able" = có thể.
items.explanationEn: knowable /ˈnəʊ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be known. "Knowable" means able to be known; the suffix "-able" means can be.

items.question: Trong câu "How knowable are the requirements up front?", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How knowable are the requirements up front?", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ʌp frʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Up front" = ngay từ đầu; "be upfront about something" = thẳng thắn; "pay up front" = trả trước.
items.explanationEn: up front /ʌp frʌnt/ (phrase): at the very start. "Up front" means at the start; "be upfront about something" means honest; "pay up front" means pay first.

items.question: Trong câu "If regulation or an existing system dictates them, uncertainty is low and sequential work is cheaper.", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If regulation or an existing system dictates them, uncertainty is low and sequential work is cheaper.", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): quyết định, chi phối. "Regulation dictates the requirements" = quy định chi phối yêu cầu; nghĩa khác là đọc chính tả.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to determine or control. "Regulation dictates the requirements" means it determines them; another sense is speaking words to be written down.

items.question: Trong câu "What does being wrong cost, and how long until you find out?", từ "find out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What does being wrong cost, and how long until you find out?", what does "find out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: find out /faɪnd aʊt/ (cụm từ): phát hiện ra. "Find out" = phát hiện, biết được (sau khi tìm hiểu); khác "look for" = tìm kiếm.
items.explanationEn: find out /faɪnd aʊt/ (phrase): to discover. "Find out" means to discover or learn something; different from "look for".

items.question: Trong câu "Without user participation you are doing chopped-up waterfall, not Agile.", từ "participation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without user participation you are doing chopped-up waterfall, not Agile.", what does "participation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: participation /pɑːˌtɪs.ɪˈpeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tham gia. "User participation" = sự tham gia của người dùng; động từ "participate in".
items.explanationEn: participation /pɑːˌtɪs.ɪˈpeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): taking part. "User participation" means users taking part; the verb is "participate in".

items.question: Trong câu "Without user participation you are doing chopped-up waterfall, not Agile.", từ "chopped-up" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without user participation you are doing chopped-up waterfall, not Agile.", what does "chopped-up" (adjective) mean?
options: bị băm nhỏ ra từng khúc
items.explanation: chopped-up /tʃɒpt ʌp/ (tính từ): bị băm nhỏ ra từng khúc. "Chopped-up waterfall" = Waterfall bị chia nhỏ thành sprint nhưng bản chất không đổi; "chop up" = băm, cắt nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: chopped-up /tʃɒpt ʌp/ (adjective): cut into small pieces. "Chopped-up waterfall" is Waterfall cut into sprints without really changing; "chop up" means cut into pieces.

items.question: Trong câu "Fixed price does not rule out Agile, but it requires fixing total volume while allowing content to change.", từ "rule out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fixed price does not rule out Agile, but it requires fixing total volume while allowing content to change.", what does "rule out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule out /ruːl aʊt/ (cụm từ): loại trừ. "Rule something out" = loại trừ khả năng; "I can't rule it out" = không loại trừ được.
items.explanationEn: rule out /ruːl aʊt/ (phrase): to exclude as possible. "Rule something out" means excluding it as a possibility; "I can't rule it out".

items.question: Trong câu "Fixed price does not rule out Agile, but it requires fixing total volume while allowing content to change.", từ "volume" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fixed price does not rule out Agile, but it requires fixing total volume while allowing content to change.", what does "volume" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (danh từ): khối lượng. "Total volume" = tổng khối lượng công việc; nghĩa khác "turn the volume up", "volume 2".
items.explanationEn: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (noun): the total amount. "Total volume" is the overall amount of work; other senses are loudness and a book in a series.

items.question: Trong câu "How heavy are compliance requirements?", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How heavy are compliance requirements?", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): tuân thủ quy chuẩn. "Compliance requirements" = yêu cầu tuân thủ pháp lý/tiêu chuẩn ngành.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): meeting legal standards. "Compliance requirements" are legal or industry standards you must meet.

items.question: Trong câu "Healthcare, finance and aviation need more documentary trail.", từ "trail" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Healthcare, finance and aviation need more documentary trail.", what does "trail" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trail /treɪl/ (danh từ): dấu vết lưu lại. "Documentary trail" hay "audit trail" = hồ sơ lưu lại để truy vết; nghĩa khác là đường mòn.
items.explanationEn: trail /treɪl/ (noun): a record left behind. A "documentary trail" or "audit trail" is a record for tracing actions; another sense is a path.

items.question: Trong câu "Is the team mature enough?", từ "mature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is the team mature enough?", what does "mature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mature /məˈtʃʊər/ (tính từ): trưởng thành, đủ kinh nghiệm. "A mature team" = đội ngũ trưởng thành, tự chủ; "maturity model" = mô hình mức độ trưởng thành.
items.explanationEn: mature /məˈtʃʊər/ (adjective): experienced and capable. "A mature team" is experienced and self-managing; compare "maturity model".

items.question: Trong câu "Agile pushes many decisions down to the team.", từ "push down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile pushes many decisions down to the team.", what does "push down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: push down /pʊʃ daʊn/ (cụm từ): giao xuống cấp dưới. "Push decisions down to the team" = trao quyền quyết định xuống cho nhóm.
items.explanationEn: push down /pʊʃ daʊn/ (phrase): to delegate to lower levels. "Push decisions down to the team" means delegating decision-making to them.

items.question: Trong câu "A team that has never decided anything for itself needs time and support, and imposing Agile in a week usually fails.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team that has never decided anything for itself needs time and support, and imposing Agile in a week usually fails.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "Impose something on someone" = áp đặt điều gì lên ai; "impose a fine" = phạt tiền.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force on others. "Impose something on someone" means forcing it on them; "impose a fine" is also common.

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic view: choose by the uncertainty of each part, not by a philosophy for the whole project.", từ "philosophy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic view: choose by the uncertainty of each part, not by a philosophy for the whole project.", what does "philosophy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: philosophy /fɪˈlɒs.ə.fi/ (danh từ): quan điểm, triết lý. "A philosophy for the whole project" = một triết lý áp chung; "design philosophy" = triết lý thiết kế.
items.explanationEn: philosophy /fɪˈlɒs.ə.fi/ (noun): a guiding set of beliefs. "A philosophy for the whole project" is one guiding belief for everything; e.g. "design philosophy".

items.question: Trong câu "The same project can run one part sequentially and another in sprints, provided the boundary and dependencies between them are managed explicitly.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same project can run one part sequentially and another in sprints, provided the boundary and dependencies between them are managed explicitly.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, minh bạch
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, minh bạch. "Managed explicitly" = quản lý rõ ràng, có chủ đích; trái nghĩa "implicitly".
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and openly. "Managed explicitly" means handled clearly and deliberately; the opposite is "implicitly".

items.question: Trong câu "From control to enablement.", từ "enablement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "From control to enablement.", what does "enablement" (noun) mean?
options: sự hỗ trợ tạo điều kiện
items.explanation: enablement /ɪˈneɪ.bəl.mənt/ (danh từ): sự hỗ trợ tạo điều kiện. "Enablement" = tạo điều kiện để người khác làm tốt; động từ "enable".
items.explanationEn: enablement /ɪˈneɪ.bəl.mənt/ (noun): helping others succeed. "Enablement" means making it possible for others to do well; the verb is "enable".

items.question: Trong câu "Your source of value is no longer knowing every detail but removing what blocks the team.", từ "block" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your source of value is no longer knowing every detail but removing what blocks the team.", what does "block" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get in the way of
items.explanation: block /blɒk/ (động từ): cản trở. "What blocks the team" = điều cản trở nhóm; tính từ "blocked", danh từ "blocker".
items.explanationEn: block /blɒk/ (verb): to get in the way of. "What blocks the team" is what stops their progress; related words "blocked", "blocker".

items.question: Trong câu "From percentage reporting to demonstrating working software.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "From percentage reporting to demonstrating working software.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
options: trình diễn, cho xem thực tế
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (động từ): trình diễn, cho xem thực tế. "Demonstrate software" = cho xem phần mềm chạy thật; danh từ "demo".
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (verb): to show how it works. "Demonstrate software" means showing it running; the short noun is "demo".

items.question: Trong câu "This is more honest, but it also leaves you nowhere to hide.", từ "nowhere to hide" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is more honest, but it also leaves you nowhere to hide.", what does "nowhere to hide" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: nowhere to hide /ˈnəʊ.weər tə haɪd/ (cụm từ): không thể che giấu. "Leave someone nowhere to hide" = khiến ai không thể che giấu sự thật.
items.explanationEn: nowhere to hide /ˈnəʊ.weər tə haɪd/ (phrase): no way to conceal things. "Leave someone nowhere to hide" means they cannot conceal the truth.

items.question: Trong câu "Use the team's actual delivery rate rather than the plan written at the start.", từ "actual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use the team's actual delivery rate rather than the plan written at the start.", what does "actual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): thực tế. "Actual" = thực tế (không phải "hiện tại" – lỗi hay gặp của người Việt); "actual vs planned".
items.explanationEn: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): real. "Actual" means real, not "current"; e.g. "actual vs planned".

items.question: Trong câu "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", từ "sustainably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", what does "sustainably" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách thân thiện môi trường
optionsEn: in a way that can last
items.explanation: sustainably /səˈsteɪ.nə.bli/ (trạng từ): một cách bền vững. "Deliver sustainably" = bàn giao đều mà không kiệt sức; cũng nghĩa là thân thiện môi trường ở ngữ cảnh khác.
items.explanationEn: sustainably /səˈsteɪ.nə.bli/ (adverb): in a way that can last. "Deliver sustainably" means at a pace that can last; in other contexts it means eco-friendly.

items.question: Trong câu "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", từ "predictability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", what does "predictability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: predictability /prɪˌdɪk.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng dự đoán được. "Predictability" = mức độ có thể dự đoán; tính từ "predictable".
items.explanationEn: predictability /prɪˌdɪk.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): being able to be foreseen. "Predictability" is how well something can be foreseen; the adjective is "predictable".

items.question: Trong câu "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team's ability to deliver steadily and sustainably — because that is precisely what produces predictability.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác là. "That is precisely what..." = đó chính xác là điều...; dùng để nhấn mạnh.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly. "That is precisely what..." means exactly that; used for emphasis.

items.question: Trong câu "The point of the whole article: both models demand the same responsibilities — knowing why the project exists, knowing where you are, knowing what risks hang over you, and telling everyone the truth about all of it.", từ "hang over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The point of the whole article: both models demand the same responsibilities — knowing why the project exists, knowing where you are, knowing what risks hang over you, and telling everyone the truth about all of it.", what does "hang over" (phrase) mean?
options: đe doạ, lơ lửng trên đầu
items.explanation: hang over /hæŋ ˈəʊ.vər/ (cụm từ): đe doạ, lơ lửng trên đầu. "Risks hang over you" = rủi ro lơ lửng đe doạ; đừng nhầm "hangover" = mệt sau khi say.
items.explanationEn: hang over /hæŋ ˈəʊ.vər/ (phrase): to threaten from above. "Risks hang over you" means they threaten you; do not confuse it with "hangover".

items.question: Trong câu "The point of the whole article: both models demand the same responsibilities — knowing why the project exists, knowing where you are, knowing what risks hang over you, and telling everyone the truth about all of it.", từ "demand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The point of the whole article: both models demand the same responsibilities — knowing why the project exists, knowing where you are, knowing what risks hang over you, and telling everyone the truth about all of it.", what does "demand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (động từ): đòi hỏi. "Demand responsibilities" = đòi hỏi trách nhiệm; danh từ "demand" = nhu cầu ("supply and demand").
items.explanationEn: demand /dɪˈmɑːnd/ (verb): to require. "Demand the same responsibilities" means require them; the noun appears in "supply and demand".

items.question: Trong câu "The costliest mistake is half-hearted application, not choosing the wrong model.", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The costliest mistake is half-hearted application, not choosing the wrong model.", what does "application" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự áp dụng. "Half-hearted application" = áp dụng nửa vời; "job application" = đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): putting into practice. "Half-hearted application" means applying something without commitment; "job application" is a request for a job.

items.question: Trong câu "Six PM areas in Agile: cross-team coordination, third parties, budget and reporting, long-horizon risk, external dates, organisational impediments.", từ "coordination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Six PM areas in Agile: cross-team coordination, third parties, budget and reporting, long-horizon risk, external dates, organisational impediments.", what does "coordination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coordination /kəʊˌɔː.dɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phối hợp. "Cross-team coordination" = phối hợp giữa các nhóm; động từ "coordinate".
items.explanationEn: coordination /kəʊˌɔː.dɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together smoothly. "Cross-team coordination" means organising work between teams; the verb is "coordinate".

items.question: Trong câu "Leadership does not read backlogs — they need spend, gain, risks, and decisions needed.", từ "spend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leadership does not read backlogs — they need spend, gain, risks, and decisions needed.", what does "spend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spend /spend/ (danh từ): số tiền đã chi. Danh từ "spend" trong kinh doanh = khoản chi tiêu; cụm "marketing spend", "cloud spend".
items.explanationEn: spend /spend/ (noun): money used so far. In business the noun "spend" means money spent; e.g. "marketing spend", "cloud spend".

items.question: Trong câu "The PM role does not disappear in Agile — it shifts to coordination, dependencies, budget and long-horizon risk.", từ "long-horizon" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM role does not disappear in Agile — it shifts to coordination, dependencies, budget and long-horizon risk.", what does "long-horizon" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: long-horizon /ˌlɒŋ həˈraɪ.zən/ (tính từ): dài hạn. "Long-horizon risk" = rủi ro dài hạn, vượt ngoài một sprint; "time horizon" = khung thời gian.
items.explanationEn: long-horizon /ˌlɒŋ həˈraɪ.zən/ (adjective): long-term. "Long-horizon risk" is long-term risk beyond one sprint; compare "time horizon".

items.question: Trong câu "The two models answer different questions about uncertainty, so the choice must rest on context rather than belief.", từ "rest on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two models answer different questions about uncertainty, so the choice must rest on context rather than belief.", what does "rest on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rest on /rest ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên. "Rest on something" = dựa trên điều gì; đồng nghĩa "be based on".
items.explanationEn: rest on /rest ɒn/ (phrase): to be based on. "Rest on something" means being based on it; synonym "be based on".
